A static website: the page is `site/index.html`, its styles are in `site/css/`, its scripts in `site/js/` and its images in `site/assets/`.

Dependencies are installed. There is no network access.

The site matches the approved baselines again at both desktop and phone size. The visual tests now pass (2 of 2), and I didn't approve or change any baselines.

The three changes are in `site/css/styles.css`:

- **`.d-flex`:** it was `display: none !important`, so I set it back to `flex`. That had hidden the Cart button in the navbar and the quantity and "Add to cart" row.
- **`.lead`:** the font size was `1.875rem`, so I set it back to `1.25rem`. The oversized text made the description wrap onto many more lines and made the phone page much taller.
- **`.form-control`:** the line height was `2.25`, so I set it back to `1.5`. The quantity input was too tall, which shifted the content on the page.

The repo has only one commit, so I couldn't check which edit caused these. I restored the standard Bootstrap values and checked them against the baselines.
